source: Textbook Arrhenius kinetics; coefficients illustrative, not calibrated.
description: Predicts yield and purity from temperature, time, catalyst loading, equivalents, concentration, solvent. Assumes first-order conversion and selectivity that drops with temperature/excess reagent.
reality_gap_notes: Known to miss: catalyst deactivation at high temperature, solvent-specific impurities, stoichiometry x concentration interactions. These are what the delta-GP learns.
